name: standup
type_hint: A daily standup. Expect terse per-person updates, several small action items, and few or no formal decisions.
text:
Daily Standup — 2026-08-18, Google Meet

Priya Raman: Yesterday I finished the retry logic on the ingest job. Today I'm picking up the dead-letter queue. No blockers.

Marcus Webb: I'm still stuck on the Cloud SQL connection pooling — it drops connections under load. I'll pair with Priya after this. That's my blocker.

Anita Desai: Shipped the dashboard filter fix. Starting on the export endpoint today. I'll need the schema frozen by Thursday or the export work slips.

Priya Raman: I can freeze the schema by Wednesday.

Marcus Webb: Also, reminder that the on-call rotation changes Monday.
